add.title: Gesetz über den Justizvollzug (Justizvollzugsgesetz, JVG) vom 13. November 2019 — Basel-Stadt detention law (TGNS)
add.summary: Primary legal text of the canton of Basel-Stadt's detention law (JVG, adopted 13 Nov 2019 by the Grand Council). §2 Trennungsvorschriften requires separation of female and male detainees and stipulates that 'the gender identity of the detained person is respected as far as possible' (Die Geschlechtsidentität der eingewiesenen Person wird soweit möglich beachtet); the prison directorate may deviate from the separation rules in consultation with the referring authority. This is the explicit 2019 inclusion of gender identity in a Swiss detention law aimed at protecting transgender people's placement in correctional facilities.

add.title: LGBTQ rights in Switzerland — placement of transgender people in correctional facilities (Wikipedia)
add.summary: Wikipedia overview of Swiss LGBTQ rights records that in November 2019 the Grand Council of Basel-Stadt voted to include 'gender identity' in its law on detention to better protect transgender people in regard to placement in correctional facilities, citing the TGNS-documented JVG. No national (federal) trans-prisoner placement rule is documented in the article — placement practice is cantonal; no Swiss case law, special trans units or federal solitary-confinement practice for trans prisoners are noted.
